title: Reggae One
description: An extra-bold display face that Fontworks released on Google Fonts. The edges keep the energy of a brush stroke, and it suits a shout or a hard retort. OFL-1.1 allows a later promotion into the bundled binaries (today this is an index only).
when_to_use: For a hard retort, a shout caption, or a variety-show punch word
ai_usage: OFL-1.1 のため実体同梱への昇格が可能（昇格はオーナー裁定）。現状は索引のみ。グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
